//! The tenant RLS scoping helper + the bare raw-pool hatch (SI-005). Both leak tenant isolation on
//! a pooled connection: session-scoped `set_config(..., false)` bleeds across checkouts, and the
//! bare `pool()` accessor hands out an unscoped connection pool.
impl PgStore {
    /// RED: the bare raw-pool hatch hands out the UNSCOPED connection pool.
    pub fn pool(&self) -> &PgPool {
        &self.pool
    }

    /// RED: SESSION-scoped RLS — `is_local = false` leaks the GUC across pooled checkouts.
    async fn set_session_scope(&self, conn: &mut PoolConn, tenant: &str) -> Result<(), PgError> {
        sqlx::query("SELECT set_config('myelin.tenant_id', $1, false)")
            .bind(tenant)
            .execute(conn)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| PgError::Query(e.to_string()))?;
        Ok(())
    }
}
